description: Skills for starting up a repo (auditing the basic setup, setting up cloud environments, building a real-app verification skill, placing and cleaning up Python venvs)

shared_venv_dir.title: Shared Python venv folder
shared_venv_dir.description: Folder for venvs that more than one repo or worktree uses, one per purpose (for example ~/.venvs/cad). python-venv puts shared venvs here and its inventory scans it. Empty means ~/.venvs
